description:
Implement the coding-side typed error layers: general code/transform errors (invalid coordinates, buffer and shape mismatches, dynamic type mismatches) and the BCH construction/decoding errors that compose or wrap them.

## Background

Error ownership follows crate direction: gf2-core owns its field and matrix-IO error types; gf2-coding owns generic code and transform errors plus BCH-specific errors that wrap or compose the general layers. Generic APIs never expose BCH-specific types. Panics remain reserved for violated internal invariants.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A coding-general error layer covers transform coordinate errors, buffer/shape mismatches, and dynamic type mismatches, free of BCH-specific types.
- [hard] REQ-02: BCH construction and decoding errors are structured, carry the mathematically relevant context, compose the general layer where applicable, and are documented with their production conditions.
title: Implement the layered typed error surface for coding APIs
